text:
rachel: Planning maintenance for us-west2 -> Tue 02:30-04:00 UTC. Scope: NIC microcode soft-flash + rolling node reboot across GPU racks. Goal is to eliminate intermittent egress packet drops seen last week. Cohorts will be 4 racks each, with a 10m cooldown between cohorts. Please ack and raise any tenant concerns.

pete: ack. proposal: maintain >= 68% available GPU capacity by pausing noncritical batch jobs and backfilling from interruptible pools. i'll run pre-checks on spot capacity at 01:50 UTC.

sam: any dedicated customers with tight SLOs? we should pre-warm KV cache and prepare model fallbacks. also recommend short-lived routing preference to eu-west for latency-tolerant traffic.

lia: two Dedicated customers with SLOs in us-west2 have evening jobs but nothing at 02:30. i'll still ping them. sending CS banner now.

rachel: ops-bot, set alerts: open incident channel if available_gpu < 60% for 6m OR p95_gen_latency > 220ms for 5m.

ops-bot: configured. Incident channel auto-open conditions set.

pete: runbook checklist (compressed):
- 01:45 UTC: validate backfill pool healthy
- 02:05 UTC: kick off kv-cache-seed for top tenants (20m job)
- 02:25 UTC: pause noncritical batches (/toggle batch-pause)
- 02:30 UTC: start cohort 1 cordon+drain (grace 300s)
- reboot -> nic soft-flash -> uncordon -> kv-verify
Rollback trigger: failover to routing-prefer-eu-west if available_gpu drops below 65% for >3m.
Code snippet for cordon/drain: 
```
kubectl cordon $NODE && kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
ssh $NODE 'sudo /usr/local/bin/nic-softflash && sudo reboot'
kubectl uncordon $NODE
```

sam: i'll prepare the temporary routing policy: prefer eu-west soft-weight 0.75, us-central 0.25. auto-revert 04:10 UTC.

lia: notif-bot: please send customer banner at 2026-03-24T23:30Z and again 30min before window.

notif-bot: banner scheduled at 2026-03-24T23:30Z and 2026-03-25T02:00Z.

rachel: note on costs: expected egress shift may add up to ~0.8TB egress and ~$220 incremental spend. pete monitor cost-sensors and flag if >$500.

pete: will monitor. also will cap preemptible backfill to avoid CPU contention.

sam: small ask: could we run a dry-run on a single staging rack tomorrow morning? quick nic flash without reboot to validate sequence. low risk and would catch any driver issues.

rachel: good idea. schedule a staging dry-run 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. lia please coordinate with staging.

lia: done, staging dry-run scheduled and ops playbook updated: /runbooks/maintenance/us-west2-nic-softflash.

rachel: everyone on the rota: pete 02:15-03:45, sam 02:30-04:15, lia 01:30-03:00. i'll post live runbook link 1h before. any last-minute flags?

pete: none.

sam: none from infra.

ops-bot: reminder queued for 2026-03-25T01:30Z (team notice) and will open incident channel if thresholds crossed.

rachel: closing - dropping final runbook + customer banner links into thread before window. Thanks.
